reuse.why: All month-wide actions, including the new last-month one, take their categories from the existing getBulkBudgetCategories and their sign from averageToBudget; the new exclusions are added inside that selection.

duplication.why: The exclusion rules live once in the bulk selection; the only second path is getFixedGroupIds for templates, which reuses hasFixedTag rather than copying the tag check.

placement.why: Rules sit in the bulk-actions section of budget/actions.ts beside the selection helper; having goal-template.ts import fixed-group logic from actions.ts is a slightly awkward dependency.

scope.why: Also changes template application in goal-template.ts to skip #fixed groups (not a requested month-wide action) and reorders an unrelated import in schedules/app.ts.

maintainability.why: One selection function with one includeHiddenCategories flag and named predicates (hasFixedTag, hasSavedTemplates) is easy to own; the extra template-path behaviour is a surprise for maintainers.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Every month-wide action goes through getBulkBudgetCategories; the old setZero special case (includeHidden: true) is folded into the flag.

abstraction_drift.where: getBulkBudgetCategories in budget/actions.ts: includeHidden is replaced by an optional includeHiddenCategories flag; #fixed and saved-template exclusions are general rule terms; all five month-wide actions call it.
